mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS "id", a.parent_id AS "parentId", a.subitem_name AS "subitemName", a.color AS "color", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks AS "remarks" FROM swm_helmet_subitem a WHERE a.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
